faqs.question: What services does 27 Creative Studio provide?
faqs.answer: We specialize in end-to-end Instagram growth and local visibility for Thoothukudi businesses: Instagram page handling, viral reels and video content, festival and offer creatives, event coverage, Google Business Profile setup, and growth strategy.

faqs.question: Which option is right for my business?
faqs.answer: Look at our 3 ways of working above: steady monthly growth suits 'Instagram page handling', targeted campaign assets suit 'Reels & video sprint', and total local dominance across multiple accounts and Google Maps becomes 'Full local growth'. We tailor every scope to what drives footfall and sales in Thoothukudi.

faqs.question: Why don't you offer rigid, one-size-fits-all quotas?
faqs.answer: Every business in Thoothukudi has different dynamics—a restaurant needs mouthwatering food close-ups and ambience, while a car showroom needs customer delivery trust and vehicle walkarounds. Forcing a rigid formula creates filler content. We shape every shoot to move real business metrics.

faqs.question: What counts as a reel and a film?
faqs.answer: A reel is a punchy vertical piece (9:16) made for high-velocity social attention and trending audio. A film is a cinematic brand cut (16:9) that anchors your business story, website, and showroom displays.

faqs.question: Can I customize an option with event coverage or a 2nd ID?
faqs.answer: Yes! Like we did for Surya Mobiles (launching a 2nd ID to scale from 0 to 1,059 followers in 30 days) and ThoorigAI Infotech (full AICCI National Startup Summit stall coverage), we customize every project to your expansion goals.

faqs.question: Which industries in Thoothukudi do you work with?
faqs.answer: We actively work with restaurants & cafés (like Thamira Restaurant), automobile showrooms (like MM Cars), retail electronics & mobile stores (like Surya Mobiles), training institutes & colleges (like ThoorigAI Infotech), and other ambitious local brands.

faqs.question: How does the growth process work from start to finish?
faqs.answer: We begin with a brief and local market audit, followed by concept planning, on-location shooting, rapid video editing with viral hooks and Tamil/English captions, and scheduled posting paired with Google Business Profile optimization.

faqs.question: What do you need from me before we start shooting?
faqs.answer: Access to your location (kitchen, showroom, or classroom), your key promotions/products, and one point of contact. We handle the creative directing, camera gear, lighting, and script hooks.

faqs.question: How far ahead should I book a shoot?
faqs.answer: 1 to 2 weeks ahead is ideal. If you have an upcoming festival, sale, or store launch in Thoothukudi, tell us early so we can plan the content runway.

faqs.question: Do you help with hooks, scripts, and trending concepts?
faqs.answer: Yes. Creative ideation, trend research, and script hooks are included in every engagement.

faqs.question: How much does it cost?
faqs.answer: Growth packages and monthly page management tailored for local businesses. Each project is scoped to your goals. WhatsApp or call us at 83004 78244 for a straightforward quotation.

faqs.question: What are your payment terms?
faqs.answer: 50% advance upon onboarding to schedule shoot dates, and 50% upon delivery of monthly assets.

faqs.question: Are there any hidden costs?
faqs.answer: No surprises. Quotes include shoot, edit, revisions, and page management. Third-party commercial music licensing outside our standard catalogue and external talent fees are quoted separately if requested.

faqs.question: How long does a typical shoot take?
faqs.answer: A focused reel shoot is typically 2 to 4 hours. A full content day or multi-camera brand film is usually 5 to 7 hours.

faqs.question: Will the shoot disrupt our daily business operations?
faqs.answer: No. We work with lean cinema equipment and fast glass, working around your staff, chefs, and customers without obstructing your floor or dining space.

faqs.question: What if it rains during outdoor shots?
faqs.answer: Outdoor shoots reschedule for rain or bad weather at no charge with 24 hours notice.

faqs.question: How fast will I get the final reels?
faqs.answer: Our standard video turnaround is 3 to 5 business days from the shoot. For urgent festival creatives or event coverage (like the AICCI National Startup Summit), we provide rapid same-week delivery.

faqs.question: What if I need changes to an edit?
faqs.answer: Every package includes 1 included review round with timecoded notes so you can request text, pacing, or audio adjustments.

faqs.question: What formats do you deliver in?
faqs.answer: Export-ready 4K and 1080p 9:16 vertical reels optimized for Instagram and YouTube Shorts, plus 16:9 master files for website and display usage.

faqs.question: Who owns the rights to the videos?
faqs.answer: Full commercial usage rights across digital, social and web in perpetuity.

faqs.question: Can I use the reels as sponsored Instagram ads?
faqs.answer: Yes. Let us know before the shoot so we design hooks, framing, and clear calls-to-action specifically tuned for high-converting Meta ads.

faqs.question: Do you handle page posting and Instagram management?
faqs.answer: We handle complete Instagram page management, hashtag optimization, and export-ready files.

faqs.question: Do you help with Google Business Profile & Maps visibility?
faqs.answer: Yes. Beyond Instagram, local visibility on Google is crucial for footfall. We set up, verify, and optimize your Google Business Profile, collect authentic reviews (like 150 reviews at 4.5/5 for Thamira Restaurant), and help local customers find you on Maps.

faqs.question: What kind of results can a Thoothukudi business expect?
faqs.answer: Across our active clients (Thamira Restaurant, MM Cars, Surya Mobiles, ThoorigAI Infotech), we generated 6,300+ new followers, up to 6.1x follower growth, and 13.6K+ top reel views, alongside direct increases in customer walk-ins and sales.

faqs.question: Can we talk before booking?
faqs.answer: Definitely. Call or WhatsApp us directly at 83004 78244 for a 15-minute intro call or WhatsApp brief.

faqs.question: Where are you based and do you shoot on-location?
faqs.answer: We are based right here in Thoothukudi (Tuticorin), Tamil Nadu. We shoot on-location at your restaurant, showroom, institute, or event venue with professional cinema gear and lighting across Thoothukudi, Tirunelveli, and surrounding districts.

faqs.question: What if I'm not sure which social strategy to take?
faqs.answer: That's exactly what we're here for. We audit your current page and local competitors, then craft a clear, actionable plan to grow your followers and customer walk-ins.

faqs.question: How do we get started?
faqs.answer: Simply call or WhatsApp us at 83004 78244, or fill out the brief form below. We will review your current online presence and map out a tailored growth strategy for your business.
